title: Old Mosul — Reconstruction & Stories of War
full_text:
8 AM Start the day with discovering the reconstruction of the old city, especially Al-Nuri Mosque and Al Hadbaa Minaret.
Walk through the area where the last and most intensive battle against ISIS took place.
Hear stories from the individuals who lived through the war.
The famous "Kubba of Mosul" for lunch — a delicious dish made by locals.
Free time in Mosul and at night visiting the café house for local music performance. This place used to be a hospital for ISIS during the battles.
